questions.q_en:
Identify whether the given statements are true or false.

A. Owl Academy was similar to any other school in the country.

B. The selection procedure at the Owl Academy was transparent.
options_en: Neither A nor B is true.
Both A and B are true.
A is true and B is false.
A is false and B is true.
questions.solution_en:
The second paragraph of the passage states that "The Owl Academy was a unique, elite school for a very select group of students..." So, the Owl Academy was unlike any other school in the country. Therefore, statement A is false.

The second paragraph also mentions that "There was no application process, no entrance exams, and no open days. Through a process known only to higher administration, students were selected from across the country and invited to attend". It can be observed from the given sentences that the selection procedure at the Owl Academy was not transparent. So, statement B is also false.

Hence, option (a) is the correct answer.

questions.q_en: Why did Tenali Raman initially write the King's name at the top of his list?

Because the King was not trustworthy.
Because the King had failed to pay the full price for the horses.

Hence, (a) is the correct answer.
